summary: Static code inspection of /app/app/(tabs)/availability.tsx for the 24h→12h AM/PM display-only fix. Expo app UI cannot be Playwright-driven in this pod (agent_to_agent_context_note), so acceptance was done by (a) reading the to12h helper and running its logic against all six required edge cases in Node, and (b) grepping the file to confirm every user-facing time site wraps values with to12h() while stored/sent values remain 24h.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 210 webAlert('Time overlap', ...) still interpolates raw 24h formStart/formEnd (e.g. '20:00–22:00'). Not in the six listed display sites but is user-facing on web when an overlap is detected.

Line 228 Alert.alert('Delete', `${DAYS_FULL[...]} ${slot.start_time}-${slot.end_time}`, ...) still renders raw 24h on iOS/Android. Web path (line 419 modal) is correctly wrapped in to12h(); this only affects the native code path.

action_items: OPTIONAL: also wrap formStart/formEnd in to12h() inside the line 210 overlap webAlert message for full US 12h consistency.
OPTIONAL: also wrap slot.start_time/slot.end_time in to12h() inside the native Alert.alert on line 228 (only affects iOS/Android).
critical_code_review_comments: to12h() helper is correct for all six required edge cases: 00:00→'12:00 AM', 06:00→'6:00 AM', 12:00→'12:00 PM', 13:30→'1:30 PM', 20:00→'8:00 PM', 23:30→'11:30 PM' (verified by executing the exact function body in Node — 6/6 passed).

All six listed display sites correctly use to12h(): TimePicker btnText (L77), option list text (L88), grid hourLabel (L308), slotTime (L321), modal summaryText (L392), delete-confirm modal text (L419).

Regression safety confirmed: HOURS[] is built as 24h 'HH:MM'/'HH:30' (L23-27); picker onChange passes raw t (24h); handleSave payload (L215) sends start_time/end_time as raw 24h; openEdit (L192-193) hydrates form from server 24h values; overlap comparator toMin() and string compare formStart>=formEnd (L208) both operate on 24h strings unchanged — backend contract preserved.
Two minor user-facing sites that were NOT in the requested six still render 24h: L210 overlap webAlert and L228 native Alert.alert delete. Consider a follow-up pass to fully de-24h the UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the six required display sites; helper 6/6 edge cases pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Testing was code-inspection only because the Expo app in this preview pod cannot be exercised by Playwright (main agent explicitly noted this). Focus of the fix was display-only 12h AM/PM. Storage/API remains 24h and is intentionally so — do NOT flag stored 24h values as a bug. Two additional user-facing time strings (L210 overlap alert, L228 native delete alert) still render 24h; they are outside the six sites the fix targeted but are worth mentioning to the main agent as an optional cleanup.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original bug: the availability screen was authored for a non-US locale and rendered raw 24h internal strings directly in the UI. Mitigation applied by main agent: added a pure to12h(t) formatter and wrapped it at the six user-facing render points while leaving HOURS[] and the API payload in 24h — a clean display-only shim. Verified correct.
